story.intro_p: For global brand clients, we offer one-stop services from ingredient traceability and formula development to smart finished-product manufacturing; we also open controlled DIY customization tools to brand clients, allowing every brand to grow its own herbal expression.
story.ferment_p: Microbial fermentation amplifies herbal actives, making ingredients gentler, easier to absorb, and delivering stable, reproducible efficacy.
story.flash_p: Short-duration low-temperature extraction preserves heat-sensitive actives, locking in the vibrant energy of botanicals with both scent and efficacy on point.
story.synbio_p: Synthetic biology precisely produces key actives with pure sourcing, batch-to-batch stability, and sustainable supply.
story.journey_p1: From the Shennong Ben Cao Jing to today's laboratories, botanicals have traveled thousands of years. Following the footsteps of ancient formulas, we visit cultivation bases, consult heritage keepers, and study classic texts to translate the wisdom of Eastern botanicals into modern skincare language.
story.journey_p2: Every plant has its origin and purpose. Our journey is to make these origins clearly visible and to have these purposes scientifically validated and felt by the skin.
story.lab_p1: The group's R&D center is equipped with a complete system for basic research, formula development, and efficacy evaluation: from active screening and stability testing to in-vivo efficacy verification, every product is backed by data.
story.lab_p2: We maintain collaborations with multiple research institutions, continuously tracking advances in synthetic biology and novel ingredients, keeping Eastern botanicals and modern science always in step.
story.farm_p1: 50+ core botanical sourcing origins globally, traceable and trackable: from growing environment and harvest timing to primary processing, every batch leaves a clear record.
story.farm_p2: Heritage formulas are our cultural foundation: we review ancient skincare recipes in classic texts, recreate and validate them with modern processes, letting ancient wisdom continue to grow in new formulations.
story.cta_p: Whether it's brand collaboration, OEM/ODM customization, or ingredient and R&D consultation, feel free to contact us.
